verdict.rationale: Shared docs and notes are a fair question for a project-management tool, so the axis applies. The evidence shows no docs or notes feature in GitHub Projects. The closest items, Markdown-formatted status update messages and draft issues, are adjacent features (a project-health update and a work item), not a way to create and organize shared documents, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can create and organize shared docs and notes alongside my project work
